messages:
Kevin (Partnerships): Quick sync — Snowbridge SI onboarding and marketplace listing. Need to confirm final adapter spec and who owns cert tests before we schedule the joint announcement next month.
Maria (Product): I chatted with marketing — they want an embargoed announcement week of May 11. That gives us ~3 weeks to finish QA and the marketplace review.
Elena (Snowbridge SI): We can finish the adapter's core mapping this week, but we need the final schema mapping for embeddings from Raj's team.
Raj (Solutions): Sending the schema doc now: https://redwood.internal/docs/snowbridge-embed-schema (draft). Note the batch ingestion schema section — we added a TTL field to support vector DB pruning.
Aj (Eng): Thx. I spotted one edge case in the embed schema: if `batch_size` > 1024 we need to chunk on the client side or we OOM. Can we cap the documented default to 512?
Sophie (Infra): Also reminder: Dedicated customers will require a private VPC connector. We need a checklist for the on-prem install path for the SI. I can draft it.
Elena (Snowbridge SI): Chunking to 512 is fine. For the market listing we also need the compatibility matrix (Snowflake versions, Databricks runtime, supported vector DBs). Elena: I'll draft a matrix and ping you.
Kevin (Partnerships): Owners: Aj — adapter runtime + stress tests; Raj — schema + sample dataset; Sophie — infra/install checklist; Elena — SI validation and compatibility matrix; Maria — announcement/messaging. Agree? @everyone :thumbsup:
Maria (Product): Agree. Marketing needs a one-pager by EOD Friday. I'll take that template.
Aj (Eng): Started a CI job: `ci/snowbridge-adapter-e2e`. Quick log snippet: ```ERROR: OOM at step encode_batch(1024)``` — I'll add the cap and rerun tonight.
marketplace-bot: Marketplace upload queued for 1918340000, status: pending review.
Raj (Solutions): For certification tests, let's use these acceptance criteria: 1) end-to-end ingest of 10k documents, 2) embedding accuracy parity within 2% of reference model, 3) auto-retry on transient network errors. I put a checklist in the doc.
Sophie (Infra): Scheduling note — if we want the May 11 announcement, marketplace review needs to be submitted by May 2 at latest to allow legal and security review.
Kevin (Partnerships): OK action items: Aj — set `batch_default=512` + push PR; Raj — finalize schema and sample set by Tue; Sophie — draft VPC/on-prem checklist by Wed; Elena — compatibility matrix draft by Thu; Maria — one-pager by Fri. I'll compile and run dry-run with marketing next Tuesday.
Elena (Snowbridge SI): Will run a field test against Qdrant and Milvus next week and report perf numbers.
Aj (Eng): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/snowbridge/pull/412 — includes chunking and a stress test.
Maria (Product): Perf numbers + one-pager will drive the hero blurb. If field tests show latency > 200ms for 1k tokens we probably need to call out recommended quantization.
Kevin (Partnerships): Noted. If anyone hits blockers, escalate in this thread and @kevin. I'll set a reminder for the milestone dates. :calendar:
Raj (Solutions): Quick Q — do we want to include Databricks delta-sharing sample in the initial listing or push to follow-up? It adds two days of docs work.
Maria (Product): Prefer to ship Snowflake + Qdrant/Milvus in week 1 and add Delta-sharing in the follow-up release to keep launch scope tight.
Elena (Snowbridge SI): Good plan. We'll validate the core flows first.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: legal review required for marketplace listing. Submit docs via the portal: https://marketplace.redwood.internal/upload
Kevin (Partnerships): Perfect — let's keep momentum. Closing for now, will post a recap tomorrow with links to PRs and the One-Pager. :rocket:
